# CoreML

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 24.9% of Apple's iOS API (236 of 947, exact) · **Rows:** 75% (2: 1 ✅ 1 🟡) · **iOS:** 11.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Imaging, photos & ML](../COVERAGE.md#ml) · **Apple:** [CoreML](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coreml) · **Issues:** [`area:ml`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Aml)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** isim parses the model specification itself and runs GLM models only. Xcode-compiled `.mlmodelc` is undocumented.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Core ML data API (`MLMultiArray`, `MLFeatureValue`, `MLDictionaryFeatureProvider`, `MLArrayBatchProvider`, `MLModelConfiguration`, `MLModelDescription`) | ✅ | ≤17 | tested (shapes, strides, subscripts, feature values) |
| Core ML models in projects (`.mlmodel`, `.mlpackage`; Xcode's generated model classes) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: `isim build` compiles each model in Compile Sources (or a synchronized folder) into `<Name>.mlmodelc` in the app with isim's format (the spec, what `MLModel(contentsOf:)` loads; a package's root model from its `Manifest.json`) instead of Apple's undocumented one, and generates Xcode's Swift classes from the model's description: `<Name>Input` / `<Name>Output` (`MLFeatureProvider`, a property per feature: Int64, Double, String, CVPixelBuffer, MLMultiArray, dictionaries, MLSequence; optional inputs), `<Name>` (`init(configuration:)`, `init(contentsOf:configuration:)`, `load(configuration:)` async and with a completion handler, `urlOfModelInThisBundle`, `prediction(input:)`, `prediction(<inputs>:)`, `predictions(inputs:options:)`); `COREML_CODEGEN_LANGUAGE = None` turns generation off. `import CoreML` re-exports Foundation, as Apple's does (the generated classes use URL and Bundle). Not generated: Objective-C model classes (isim's Core ML has no Objective-C interface yet). What a model can predict is the next row. Tested (HelloCoreMLModels: test_generated_model_classes, test_coreml_models) |
| Core ML `MLModel` loading and prediction | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: Apple's compiled `.mlmodelc` format is undocumented and needs Apple's runtime, so Xcode-compiled models fail to load with a clear error (tested); `MLModel.compileModel(at:)` turns a `.mlmodel` spec into an isim `.mlmodelc`; descriptions are read for every model type; predictions run for GLM regressors/classifiers only (tested); neural networks, ML programs, trees and pipelines fail with a clear error (tested) |
